channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday competitions 2026 (Australia)
channel.description: Competitions and giveaways open to Australian residents that are tied to Black Friday (Friday 27 November 2026) and Cyber Monday (30 November), each checked on the promoter's own page. Many close within days of Black Friday, so check the closing date on each one. Only entries we have confirmed as open are listed. Below them are other open competitions that are not tied to Black Friday.

item.title: St Frock Win Your Wishlist (Black Friday) – St Frock
item.description: Prize: 5 winners each receive their wishlist worth up to AUD $500. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Join the St Frock Black Friday VIP list, create an account and build your wishlist. Free, Australian residents 18+. 2–15 Nov 2026, winners announced 16 Nov

item.title: EOS Footwear Black Friday Wardrobe Win: $1,000 voucher – EOS Footwear (Urban Shoemakers Pty Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One $1,000 EOS Footwear voucher. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter your details in the form on the page. Australian residents 18+. Closes 23:59 AEDT on 29 November 2026; winner drawn by 30 November

item.title: Los Cabos Black Friday Wardrobe Win: $500 voucher – Los Cabos Shoes (Urban Shoemakers Pty Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One AUD $500 Los Cabos voucher. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up via the form on the Black Friday Wardrobe Win page. Free, Australian residents 18+, not valid for existing subscribers. 15 Oct 2:30pm – 29 Nov 2026 11:59pm AEDT, winner by 30 Nov

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (AU) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV A$1,299) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Australian residents 18+. Closes 1 December 2026, 3:59 PM AEDT

item.title: ST.SAJ Black Friday VIP Giveaway: $500 cash – ST.SAJ
item.description: Prize: AUD $500 cash. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on the ST.SAJ Black Friday page (signup also gives a $15 voucher). Free, one entry, Australian residents 18+. 17 Oct – 30 Nov 2026 11:59pm AEDT, draw 1 Dec
